source.title: Distinct effects of reward and navigation history on hippocampal forward and reverse replays
source.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

confidence_rationale: Strong source (PNAS, rat tetrode recording, well-controlled dissociation of reward from navigation history). Mapping fidelity is the limiting term (0.50): the value signal is found in REPLAY CONTENT, a different variable from the place-field geometry MECH-143 asserts, so the paper neither confirms nor refutes the claim on its own terms -- it relocates where value lives. Net 0.52, deliberately below the 0.5-0.79 band's midpoint.
failure_signatures: Reward selectively increases the fidelity of forward replays for high-value trajectories, so value information demonstrably enters dorsal hippocampal sequence content even where place-field geometry is unchanged.

The authors propose explicitly that hippocampal replay constructs a map of potential trajectories AND their associated values -- a 'value map' -- which is incompatible with reading the dorsal hippocampus as a wholly value-free structure.
MECH-143's no-new-value-computation constraint is therefore only defensible if stated at the level of place-field geometry; stated at the level of dorsal hippocampal output it is false.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Reward enhances the rate of reverse replay and the fidelity of forward replay for trajectories heading toward rewarding locations, with preferential reactivation of upcoming over already-rewarded trajectories; the authors propose that forward and reverse replays jointly construct a map of potential navigation trajectories and their associated values.
mapping.ree_translation: Cuts across MECH-143 rather than along it. The claim is about place-field geometry; this paper measures replay content. Both can be true: fields stable, replay value-weighted. For REE that is a substantive finding rather than a technicality, because ARC-007's trajectory PROPOSER is functionally much closer to forward replay than to the static place map -- so a value signal in forward replay lands on exactly the component ARC-007 wants to keep value-free. The claim as worded is not refuted; the architectural constraint it was registered to support is.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The identification of ARC-007's proposal module with hippocampal forward replay is REE's architectural analogy, not an empirical result -- and it is the entire load-bearing step here. If that analogy is rejected, this paper says little about MECH-143 either way. Rat data, awake replay during a spatial sequence memory task; no aversive condition, so nothing here speaks to the negative half of the residue field.
mapping.source_context: Rats trained on a spatial sequence memory task; tetrode recording of awake forward and reverse replay events, with reward and navigation history dissociated.

confidence_components.notes: Deliberate split: excellent evidence about a variable adjacent to the one the claim names. transfer_risk raised to 0.40 because the proposer-equals-forward-replay identification is an unvalidated architectural analogy.
